title: ESL Instructor, Academic Supervisor & Bilingual Translator
summary: Dedicated ESL Instructor and Academic Secondary Supervisor committed to fostering student success through results-oriented teaching methodologies. Native Arabic speaker with C1 Advanced English proficiency.
